# Contents

Figure 5 stacks two presence/absence panels that share **one taxon set in one column order**:

* **5A** heterotrophy/phagotrophy features carried by at least 3 lineages (as `fig_pa_heterotrophy_split` in 06);
* **5B** osmotrophy, symbiosis and parasitism features carried by at least 1 lineage (as `fig_pa_other`).

The shared taxon set is the union of the taxa shown in either panel. A taxon with no features in a
panel shows as white (absent) tiles: `06_panel_taxon_pa_matrix.csv` is a full taxon × feature
cross join, so absence is an explicit row.

Presence calls are the 06 rule (the 05 count rule, 2026-11-23): *present* = detected in ≥ 3 of 13
vent or ≥ 3 of 6 non-vent samples, and ≥ 6 of 19 all samples (30%) for the all-samples call that
selects Fig 5 rows; *below threshold* = detected in ≥ 1 sample but below that bar;
*absent* = never detected. A feature in two trophic modes is drawn once, in its primary mode
(the 06 `panel_plot` rule).

Two alternative layouts follow the main figure:

* **Alt 1, one tile per pair:** each taxon × feature tile gets a single colour for where it is
  present (both habitats, vent only, non-vent only, detected below threshold, absent). Easier to
  read than split triangles at journal size.
* **Alt 2, subcategory roll-up:** rows are subcategories rather than features; each tile is the
  number of features present, labelled "both / total". Much shorter figure; the feature-level
  detail moves to a supplementary table.

# Set up


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
source(if (file.exists("_setup.R")) "_setup.R" else "scripts/_setup.R")
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
PA_MATRIX   <- "output-tables/06_panel_taxon_pa_matrix.csv"  # from 06 (taxon x feature, every pair)
PANEL_TABLE <- "output-tables/06_panel_habitat.csv"         # from 06 (feature labels, primary mode)
SETS_TABLE   <- "data/gene-lists/trophic_gene_sets.csv"      # scripts/00_build_gene_sets.R
EXPERIMENTAL <- "data/gene-lists/protist_phagotrophy_experimental.csv"

FIG5_A_MODES <- "Heterotrophy/phagotrophy"
FIG5_B_MODES <- c("Osmotrophy", "Symbiosis", "Parasitism")
FIG5_A_MIN_TAXA <- 3   # 5A: features present (all samples) in >= 3 lineages, as in 06
FIG5_B_MIN_TAXA <- 1   # 5B: every feature present in >= 1 lineage, as in 06

# Figure 4 lineages, printed in bold on the x-axis so the two figures read together
FIG4_TAXA <- c("Anaeramoeba", "Metamonada (unres.)", "Parablepharismea", "Dysnectes",
               "Spirotrichea", "Florideophyceae", "Euglenozoa")

pa_states <- c(present = "Present (>= 3 samples)",
               below_threshold = "Detected, below threshold",
               absent = "Not detected")
panel_pal <- list(vent    = c(present = "#b74a70", below_threshold = "#ecd0db", absent = "white"),
                  nonvent = c(present = "#346D6E", below_threshold = "#cfe2e2", absent = "white"))
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
panel_features <- read_csv(PANEL_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(feature_id, primary_category, subcategory, gene_disp, feature_lab, shared)

taxon_pa_matrix <- read_csv(PA_MATRIX, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(cur_group, cur_L4, taxon, feature_id, vent, nonvent, all_samples) |>
  inner_join(panel_features, by = "feature_id")
stopifnot(!anyNA(taxon_pa_matrix$primary_category))

grp <- unique(taxon_pa_matrix$cur_group)
grp_levels <- c(intersect(SUPERGROUP_0_ordering, grp), setdiff(grp, SUPERGROUP_0_ordering))

message(glue("{n_distinct(taxon_pa_matrix$cur_L4)} lineages x {n_distinct(taxon_pa_matrix$feature_id)} features"))
```

```{.r .cell-code}
# y-axis labels: trailing * = protist experimental phagotrophy gene; bold KO id = Burns et al.
# 2018 family; dagger = feature also in another trophic mode (same convention as 06)
burns_ids <- read_csv(SETS_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(set_source == "burns2018") |> distinct(ko_id) |> pull(ko_id)
experimental_ids <- read_csv(EXPERIMENTAL, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(ko_id, pfam_acc) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), values_to = "id") |>
  separate_longer_delim(id, ";") |>
  mutate(id = str_squish(id)) |>
  filter(!is.na(id), id != "") |>
  distinct(id) |> pull(id)

feature_label_fun <- function(x) {
  hit <- panel_features[match(x, panel_features$feature_lab), ]
  lapply(seq_along(x), \(i) {
    gene <- hit$gene_disp[i]; id <- hit$feature_id[i]
    star <- paste0(if (id %in% experimental_ids) "*" else "",
                   if (isTRUE(hit$shared[i])) "†" else "")
    if (id %in% burns_ids) bquote(paste(.(gene), " (", bold(.(id)), ")", .(star)))
    else                   bquote(paste(.(gene), " (", .(id), ")", .(star)))
  }) |> as.expression()
}
taxon_label_fun <- function(x) {
  lapply(x, \(t) if (t %in% FIG4_TAXA) bquote(bold(.(t))) else t) |> as.expression()
}
pa_caption <- paste("* protist phagotrophy experimental gene; bold KO id = Burns et al. 2018 family;",
                    "† also in another trophic mode; bold lineage = discussed with Figure 4")
```
:::


# Shared taxon set


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# features of the given modes, filtered to those present (all samples) in >= min_taxa lineages
pa_frame <- function(modes, min_taxa) {
  df <- taxon_pa_matrix |> filter(primary_category %in% modes)
  kept <- df |>
    filter(all_samples == "present") |>
    distinct(feature_id, cur_L4) |>
    count(feature_id) |>
    filter(n >= min_taxa)
  df |> filter(feature_id %in% kept$feature_id)
}

# lineages a frame would show on its own: >= 1 feature present in vent, non-vent or all samples
pa_shown_taxa <- function(df) {
  df |>
    filter(vent == "present" | nonvent == "present" | all_samples == "present") |>
    distinct(cur_L4) |> pull()
}

# restrict to the shared taxa and set factor orders for plotting
pa_prepare <- function(df, taxa, taxon_levels) {
  feature_order <- df |>
    summarise(n = sum(all_samples == "present"), .by = feature_lab) |>
    arrange(n) |> pull(feature_lab)
  df |>
    filter(cur_L4 %in% taxa) |>
    mutate(cur_group   = factor(cur_group, levels = grp_levels),
           taxon       = factor(taxon, levels = taxon_levels),
           feature_lab = factor(feature_lab, levels = feature_order),
           mode        = str_wrap(primary_category, 12),
           subcategory = str_wrap(subcategory, 18))
}
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
fig5_a_df <- pa_frame(FIG5_A_MODES, FIG5_A_MIN_TAXA)
fig5_b_df <- pa_frame(FIG5_B_MODES, FIG5_B_MIN_TAXA)

taxa_a <- pa_shown_taxa(fig5_a_df)
taxa_b <- pa_shown_taxa(fig5_b_df)
fig5_taxa <- union(taxa_a, taxa_b)
# Figure 4 lineages with no panel feature (e.g. Anaeramoeba, Dysnectes) are added as all-absent
# columns so their absence is visible next to Figure 4; set FALSE to drop them
INCLUDE_FIG4_TAXA <- TRUE
if (INCLUDE_FIG4_TAXA) {
  fig5_taxa <- union(fig5_taxa, taxon_pa_matrix |> filter(taxon %in% FIG4_TAXA) |>
                                  distinct(cur_L4) |> pull())
}

# column order: most features present (all samples) across both panels first
fig5_taxon_levels <- bind_rows(fig5_a_df, fig5_b_df) |>
  filter(cur_L4 %in% fig5_taxa) |>
  summarise(n = sum(all_samples == "present"), .by = taxon) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |> pull(taxon) |> unique()

message(glue("Figure 5: {length(fig5_taxa)} lineages; {length(setdiff(fig5_taxa, taxa_a))} added to 5A ",
             "and {length(setdiff(fig5_taxa, taxa_b))} added to 5B as all-absent columns"))
```

Figure 5: 99 lineages; 6 added to 5A and 55 added to 5B as all-absent columns

```{.r .cell-code}
fig5_a <- pa_prepare(fig5_a_df, fig5_taxa, fig5_taxon_levels)
fig5_b <- pa_prepare(fig5_b_df, fig5_taxa, fig5_taxon_levels)
```

# Supplementary Figure 5: all lineages (split tiles, as in 06)

Each tile is cut on the bottom-left to top-right diagonal: vent = top-left triangle, non-vent =
bottom-right triangle.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Polygons sit on a discrete axis set by an invisible geom_tile(), so free facet scales still
# collapse to the taxa/features in each facet; triangle coordinates use each tile's position
# within its facet (rank among levels present there). Same code as 06 plot_taxon_pa(split_tiles).
plot_pa_split <- function(df, base_size = 6, show_x = TRUE) {
  split_pal <- c(setNames(panel_pal$vent,    paste0("vent.",    names(panel_pal$vent))),
                 setNames(panel_pal$nonvent, paste0("nonvent.", names(panel_pal$nonvent))))
  split_labs <- c(vent.present = "Vent: present", vent.below_threshold = "Vent: below threshold",
                  vent.absent = "Vent: absent", nonvent.present = "Non-vent: present",
                  nonvent.below_threshold = "Non-vent: below threshold",
                  nonvent.absent = "Non-vent: absent")
  df <- df |>
    mutate(px = dense_rank(as.integer(taxon)),       .by = cur_group) |>
    mutate(py = dense_rank(as.integer(feature_lab)), .by = c(mode, subcategory))
  poly <- bind_rows(mutate(df, half = "vent",    state = as.character(vent)),
                    mutate(df, half = "nonvent", state = as.character(nonvent))) |>
    mutate(tile_id = row_number(), key = paste(half, state, sep = ".")) |>
    cross_join(tibble(v = 1:3)) |>
    mutate(ox = if_else(half == "vent", c(-.5, -.5, .5)[v], c(-.5, .5, .5)[v]),
           oy = if_else(half == "vent", c(-.5, .5, .5)[v], c(-.5, -.5, .5)[v]),
           x = px + ox, y = py + oy)

  ggplot() +
    geom_tile(data = df, aes(taxon, feature_lab), fill = NA, colour = NA) +
    geom_polygon(data = poly, aes(x, y, group = tile_id, fill = key),
                 color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = split_pal, labels = split_labs, drop = FALSE, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = taxon_label_fun) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = feature_label_fun) +
    facet_grid(mode + subcategory ~ cur_group, scales = "free", space = "free") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
          axis.text.x = if (show_x) element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, color = "black")
                        else element_blank(),
          strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, size = base_size - 1, color = "black"),
          strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, size = base_size - 1, color = "black"))
}
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# x-axis labels on the bottom panel only; supergroup strips on both
fig5 <- plot_pa_split(fig5_a, show_x = FALSE) / plot_pa_split(fig5_b) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(n_distinct(fig5_a$feature_lab), n_distinct(fig5_b$feature_lab)),
              guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A", title = "Vent (top left) | Non-vent (bottom right)",
                  caption = pa_caption) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
fig5
```

# Figure 5, main text (reduced lineage set)

<!-- >SKH: 2026-11-21 main-text version. The full figure above (`fig5`) is the supplementary figure. -->

The supplementary figure (`fig5` above) keeps every lineage. The main-text version drops the
Opisthokonta, Archaeplastida and Alveolata-Unannotated supergroups, and any lineage with fewer than
`MAIN_MIN_FEATURES` features present (vent or non-vent) across both panels. Figure 4 lineages are kept
regardless of either rule (`MAIN_KEEP_FIG4`), so their absence stays visible and Florideophyceae stays in. Feature rows and column order are the
same as the supplementary figure.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
MAIN_DROP_GROUPS  <- c("Opisthokonta", "Archaeplastida", "Alveolata-Unannotated")
MAIN_MIN_FEATURES <- 2      # drop lineages with only 1 feature present
MAIN_KEEP_FIG4    <- TRUE   # keep Figure 4 lineages regardless of group or MAIN_MIN_FEATURES

main_taxon_counts <- bind_rows(fig5_a, fig5_b) |>
  summarise(n_present = sum(vent == "present" | nonvent == "present"),
            .by = c(cur_group, taxon))

fig5_main_taxa <- main_taxon_counts |>
  # >SKH: 2026-11-22 Figure 4 lineages bypass both the group drop and the minimum (keeps Florideophyceae)
  filter((!cur_group %in% MAIN_DROP_GROUPS & n_present >= MAIN_MIN_FEATURES) |
           (MAIN_KEEP_FIG4 & taxon %in% FIG4_TAXA)) |>
  pull(taxon) |> as.character()

message(glue("Main-text Figure 5: {length(fig5_main_taxa)} of {nrow(main_taxon_counts)} lineages"))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr}

```
Main-text Figure 5: 61 of 99 lineages
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
fig5_main_a <- fig5_a |> filter(taxon %in% fig5_main_taxa) |> mutate(taxon = fct_drop(taxon))
fig5_main_b <- fig5_b |> filter(taxon %in% fig5_main_taxa) |> mutate(taxon = fct_drop(taxon))
```
